item.title: Predictions for Las Vegas real estate in 2026
item.description: There won’t be a crash. But it’s not going to be a 2021-style feeding frenzy either. 2026 is going to be a year where the market rewards those that are serious about a fair deal on both sides. Those who know what they want, get strategic and don’t get emotionally sidetracked every time the headlines get dramatic.

item.title: Coronado boys claim 5A state bowling title — PHOTOS
item.description: Coronado defeated Shadow Ridge on Friday to claim the 5A boys state bowling championship at the Orleans Bowling Center.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Welfare dollars are being wasted
item.description: All too frequently, government programs for sympathetic causes frequently have comical levels of fraud.

item.title: LETTER: Animal shelters won’t help feral cats
item.description: Mobile sterilization efforts could curb the population.

item.title: LETTER: Dealing with water in the Southwest
item.description: We have the ability to improve things. Do we have the will?

item.title: Rebels rally from 23-point deficit, shock Boise State in overtime
item.description: Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn finished with a career-high 36 points, and the UNLV basketball team rallied to beat Boise State in overtime for the second time this season.

item.title: Mater East, Losee reach 4A girls basketball state tourney — PHOTOS
item.description: Mater East and Losee will play for the Class 4A girls basketball Southern Region title Saturday at Foothill. Both teams advance to next week’s 4A state tournament.

item.title: Clark tops Palo Verde in Southern Region semifinals, advances to state — PHOTOS
item.description: Devan Christion scored 13 of his game-high 30 points in the third quarter, helping Clark to a win in the Class 4A Southern Region boys basketball semifinals.

item.title: 3A-1A basketball playoff roundup: The Meadows boys reach 3A region final
item.description: The Meadows’ boys basketball team will play for the Class 3A Southern Region title on Saturday. Here’s a roundup of the Class 3A, 2A and 1A action.
